page.overview:
Who is Wendell Hunt?

Wendell Hunt is a character created by American author David Kenney for his Lost Archivist series of Cthulhu Mythos stories. He made his first appearance in the 2019 short story "The Lost Archivist."

Hunt is the chief archivist of Miskatonic University's Armitage Memorial Library. In this capacity, he encounters a variety of supernatural forces, including covetous necromancers amongst the faculty and zombies, amongst others. He is assisted in his tasks by his boss Dr. Clara Pedrick and the insane researcher Dr. Shattuck, both of whom have extensive experience in the field.

During the course of his duties, hunt has suffered some serious and permanent physical disfigurements, including the loss of an eye on one occasion, and an ear on another.

During his investigation of theft and murder at one of the library’s most dangerous departments, Storage Area B, Hunt confronted and defeated a magic-wielding professor and his zombie minion. He is able to overcome the threat and restore balance to the archives, but loses his ear to the zombie's hungry jaws in the process (: "Gnashing Whispers")
